eval.sample:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to spin around and around, but her mommy always had to go to the doctor to take care of her.

One day, Lily's mommy gave her a new player. It was a shiny red ball and she loved it. Lily was so happy and she played with it all day long.

In the end, Lily's mommy gave her a big, yummy cookie. Lily was very happy and she ate the cookies. When she got home, she put the new snack away and went to sleep with a smile on her face.
